title: Grouping words
description:
Write `final class Words` with two methods, each one stream with one `collect`:

- `static TreeMap<Integer, List<String>> byLength(List<String> words)`: words grouped by length, each group sorted alphabetically without duplicates.
- `static Map<Character, Long> firstLetters(List<String> words)`: how many words start with each letter, lower-cased, ignoring empty strings; the map's keys in alphabetical order.
hints: `groupingBy(key, TreeMap::new, downstream)` picks the map type; a `TreeSet` downstream sorts and removes duplicates (lesson 8.03).

`Collectors.collectingAndThen(collector, finisher)` runs a collector and then applies a function to its result: `collectingAndThen(Collectors.toCollection(TreeSet::new), ArrayList::new)` collects each group into a `TreeSet` and turns it into a `List` at the end.
